seo.homeTitle: EcoMind Myanmar — Scan waste, request pickup, earn Green Points
seo.homeDescription: Connect with verified collectors in Yangon, Mandalay, and nationwide. Schedule doorstep pickups, get fair scrap rates, and earn Green Points.
seo.defaultDescription: Community recycling platform for Myanmar. Scan waste, book doorstep pickups, find drop-off hubs, and earn Green Points.
